study.question: Can localized native-width reduction in advertisement-ID or item-attribute embeddings retain source click AUC while reducing parameters and measured prediction cost? Broad item/action reduction previously lost quality: g1-r0011-context16_item8 AUC 0.6585912063 versus source 0.6606469405; context-only copied reduction reached 0.6600942671 but p50 11.7183 ms was close to source 11.7262 ms. Native context8/item16 reached only 0.6593228894. None of these observations identifies redundancy within the item fields.
study.hypothesis: Item representation capacity is unevenly useful across advertisement identity and reusable attributes. Broad item compression may have removed needed capacity from one group while unnecessarily retaining width in another. Narrowing only one group may recover click quality relative to narrowing both, with lower total storage and possibly inference cost than full16. Competing possibilities are that identity memorization needs full width, attributes need full width, or both do. The study does not assume either direction wins. Existing all-item/native and copied-width failures motivate localization, not a claim of proven redundancy.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines 219-274 establishes concatenated field embeddings, target-conditioned activation and unnormalized weighted pooling, all inherited here. This study changes field-specific native widths inside a previously adapted compressed four-task network; no DIN reproduction or priority claim.

candidate.py/source ancestor and baseline_reference.py read. Inherit the stronger source operator, compression, four heads and gradient gates; replace uniform item-field width with two explicit capacity factors. The full16 endpoint preserves the source operator and initialization order.

Read supplied standalone native-width ancestor sources and validation receipts. Earlier group was item plus action, and all item fields changed together. New experiment splits item_id from other item fields and fixes action/context at16. Earlier scores are historical evidence, not matched controls for this factorial.

Pinned benchmark source lines 59-118 and 131-165 separately configures identifier and attribute widths, then uses target attention, tokens and interaction blocks. We use the capacity distinction only, with no separate ID tokens, expanded user IDs or new interaction stack. Only supplied item_id is used. This is benchmark-implementation inspection, not verification of the original Zenith paper.
Registry provides original-paper provenance but content_read=false. Original primary mechanism and originality relative to it remain unverified; no novelty or original-method reproduction claim.

study.proposed_difference: Two native-width factors: advertisement item_id at 8/16, other non-meta source=item fields at 8/16. Non-item context and action remain16. Local copied metadata resolves aliases to the maximum requested width of their shared group. No projections or extra learned modules are introduced. Four standalone cells isolate each factor and their joint effect. This is an empirical capacity allocation test, not a claimed new architecture.
predictions: Full16 must reproduce source predictions/gradients under host numerical checks and its recorded 32060453 parameters, subject to the unchanged host schema. Same-seed training should reproduce 0.660646940486458 click AUC; failure blocks interpreting the reduced cells until diagnosed.

If one group is less capacity-sensitive, its one-factor reduction should lose less click AUC than id8_attr8; the reverse cell distinguishes which group is implicated. Both being sensitive is an admissible null result.

Predeclare provisional retention as paired validation click AUC delta >= -0.0005 relative to the new full16 cell, with lower actual total parameters. A useful efficiency target additionally requires >=10% parameter reduction and >=5% lower model-only p50 and p95 latency. All thresholds are practical screening criteria, not significance tests.

Report actual trainable/embedding/dense/total parameters, training and allocated GPU seconds, wall time, peak memory, full-validation inference seconds/throughput and p50/p95 batch latency. Do not infer speed from width or parameter count.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values and auxiliary mean separately. Evaluate existing empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history bins, reporting sample, positive and derived negative counts; mark empty-history positives=427 as a small exploratory slice. Additional hour/frequency/missing/composition slices require host-authorized fields/receipts; they are not forward inputs and are not available here.

Before training, host must verify actual alias ownership/effective widths, untouched host metadata, forward/backward finite outputs [B,1] for four tasks, mask invariance for padded values including empty histories, target-action invariance and auxiliary gradient gates. Metadata-only tests here do not establish those numerical properties.
falsifiers: Both isolated reductions lose more than 0.0005 click AUC relative to a compatible full16 control; this rejects retention for the tested allocations and seed, not every mixed-width design.
A smaller cell fails to reduce measured latency, or fails to save parameters because aliases protect the widths; then the proposed joint efficiency benefit is unsupported even if AUC is retained.
Any observed gain is explained by greater capacity/compute rather than a favorable measured quality/cost frontier; unequal-budget group comparisons alone do not establish field semantics.

A full-width reproduction mismatch, missing information/masking invariant, nonfinite gradient, or unexpected cross-source alias blocks mechanistic interpretation rather than counting as scientific evidence against capacity allocation.
alternative_explanations: Width changes alter random-number consumption, initialization scales and optimizer trajectories; same seed is not matched initial weights.
ID and attribute groups differ in vocabulary size and number of fields; comparisons between one-factor cells are not parameter- or FLOP-matched.
All observed trajectories use one training seed; replay consistency is not independent repetition.
Cross-group aliases can protect widths or make factors overlap; audit actual owner groups before interpreting factorial effects.

Native-width layout already changed click AUC relative to copied context layouts at similar table budgets; readout conditioning and optimizer behavior can explain differences without semantic redundancy.
Timing is sensitive to kernel alignment, loading and allocator effects; native width12 previously saved parameters without convincing p50 benefit.

Auxiliary labels are user/category/brand matches within24h, and prior source click gains coexist with substantially worse auxiliary AUC than DIN. Click selection does not establish superior four-task performance or advertisement conversion attribution.
Single-pass benchmark and inherited offline visibility limit transfer; no production point-in-time or external-task claim.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: All four factorial cells, static checks, host diagnostics, controls, failed attempts and retries count. Preserve at least 12000 s for compatibility failure diagnosis, closest native/copy replacements or capacity-matched follow-up and paired repeats if this direction merits continuation. The proposed factorial is deliberately not parameter matched; no matched-capacity causal claim will be made.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Preserve at least 12000 s for the selected candidate, unchanged source and closest successful control with up to three paired seeds when feasible, uncertainty/cluster-bootstrap analysis if host supplies authorized per-user data, inference timing repetition, and a frozen final comparison suite. Seed remains host-owned. No holdout call or suite selection is requested in this proposal. Withheld results must stay in the closed assessment archive.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not train or install in this proposal phase. Host numerical compatibility and information gates precede substantive runs; failures remain charged. Obey per-trial and campaign hard limits and reserve budgets; never raise limits. Stop/diagnose on integrity failures; if no reduced cell retains quality or no admissible useful follow-up fits, report null/negative outcomes and retain the source. Freeze selected hashes/config/checkpoints/commands and comparisons using validation only before any withheld assessment.
